services.kierratys.title: Recycling and waste removal — we handle the transport and sorting
services.kierratys.description: A full attic, cellar or storage unit? We carry, sort and take your items to the right place — you only pay the waste fee directly to the recycling station, we take care of the rest.
services.kierratys.valueProposition: An easy way to responsibly get rid of extra items.
services.kierratys.includes.0: Home clear-outs and move-out cleaning items
services.kierratys.includes.2: Mixed waste, wood, metal, cardboard and other recyclable waste
services.kierratys.includes.3: Large and heavy items that won't fit in your own car
services.kierratys.pricingDescription: The price of our recycling service is based on the time spent on transport and sorting plus the distance — it does not include the recycling station's waste fee, which is always paid separately directly to the station.
kierratys.step1.title: 1. Tell us what needs to go
kierratys.step1.description: Fill in the form: what kind of items or waste, the estimated amount (e.g. "a full van of mixed waste"), the pickup address and your preferred time.
kierratys.step2.title: 2. We agree on a time
kierratys.step2.description: We confirm the pickup time and send you instructions for paying the waste fee in the recycling station's web shop.
kierratys.step3.title: 3. You pay the waste fee directly to the recycling station
kierratys.step3.description: The waste fee is paid in advance in the recycling station's own web shop using our vehicle's registration number — it does not go through us, so the payment goes straight to the right place.
kierratys.step4.title: 4. Pickup and sorting
kierratys.step4.description: We arrive on the agreed day, carry the items out and sort them into the correct fractions (mixed waste, metal, wood, electrical appliances, etc.) before taking them to the recycling station.
kierratys.step5.title: 5. An invoice for the work only
kierratys.step5.description: We invoice you only for the transport and sorting work — the waste fee has already been handled separately, so your invoice is clear and transparent.
kierratys.step6.title: 6. Paying the waste fee at the recycling station
kierratys.step6.description: Once the pickup time is confirmed, we'll direct you to Kiertokapula's web shop, where you pay the waste fee in advance. Remember to enter our vehicle's registration number with the payment — it lets us enter the recycling station.
kierratys.shop_note: We'll also email you detailed instructions and the registration number when we confirm the pickup time.
kierratys.price_fee_note: The waste fee depends on the waste type and amount — you'll see the exact price in the recycling station's web shop before paying
kierratys.price_example: Example: A full van of mixed waste
kierratys.price_example_fee: waste fee to the recycling station approx.
kierratys.excludes_note: Does not include hazardous waste, e.g. paints, chemicals or batteries — please ask about these separately.
kierratys.faq1.question: Why am I paying two parties?
kierratys.faq1.answer: The waste fee goes directly to the recycling station because it is a statutory waste handling fee that we cannot and may not invoice ourselves. Our invoice covers only the transport and sorting work.
kierratys.faq2.question: How soon does the waste fee need to be paid?
kierratys.faq2.answer: We recommend paying only once the pickup time has been confirmed with us — the payment is valid for 30 days from the time of payment.
kierratys.faq3.question: What if I don't know the exact amount in advance?
kierratys.faq3.answer: No problem — we'll estimate it together, and if needed you can add more waste in the recycling station's web shop before the pickup day.
